```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)

if (file.exists("../.env")) readRenviron("../.env")
source("../R/supabase.R")
source("../R/analytics.R")
source("../R/lines.R")
source("../R/rink_plot.R")

# Brand colors (defined in global.R for the app, which the report never loads)
VT_MAROON <- "#861F41"
VT_ORANGE <- "#E5751F"

# ── Two-team shot map: VT in maroon, opponent in navy — circles for
# saves/on-goal, star for goals. Only on-goal results shown (save/goal);
# missed and blocked shots are excluded from this view.
draw_rink_both_teams <- function(shots_df, attack_right = TRUE) {
  base <- draw_rink(attack_right = attack_right)  # rink + danger zones, no shots

  on_goal <- shots_df[!is.na(shots_df$result) &
                      shots_df$result %in% c("save", "goal"), ]

  vt_saves  <- on_goal[on_goal$team == "VT"  & on_goal$result == "save", ]
  vt_goals  <- on_goal[on_goal$team == "VT"  & on_goal$result == "goal", ]
  opp_saves <- on_goal[on_goal$team != "VT"  & !is.na(on_goal$team) & on_goal$result == "save", ]
  opp_goals <- on_goal[on_goal$team != "VT"  & !is.na(on_goal$team) & on_goal$result == "goal", ]

  VT_FILL  <- "#861F41"
  OPP_FILL <- "#1a3a6b"

  if (nrow(vt_saves) > 0) {
    base <- base +
      geom_point(data = vt_saves, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord),
                shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 1.2,
                fill = VT_FILL, color = "black", alpha = 0.9)
  }
  if (nrow(opp_saves) > 0) {
    base <- base +
      geom_point(data = opp_saves, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord),
                shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 1.2,
                fill = OPP_FILL, color = "black", alpha = 0.9)
  }
  if (nrow(vt_goals) > 0) {
    base <- base +
      geom_point(data = vt_goals, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord),
                shape = 8, size = 5, stroke = 2, color = VT_FILL)
  }
  if (nrow(opp_goals) > 0) {
    base <- base +
      geom_point(data = opp_goals, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord),
                shape = 8, size = 5, stroke = 2, color = OPP_FILL)
  }

  base +
    annotate("point", x = -6, y = -4, shape = 8, size = 3, stroke = 1.5, color = VT_FILL) +
    annotate("text",  x = -1, y = -4, label = "VT Goal", hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
    annotate("point", x = -6, y = -10, shape = 8, size = 3, stroke = 1.5, color = OPP_FILL) +
    annotate("text",  x = -1, y = -10, label = "Opponent Goal", hjust = 0, size = 3.2)
}
```

```{r load-data}
#| include: false

players  <- sb_select("players",  filters = c("active" = "eq.true"),
                      order = "jersey_num.asc")
games    <- sb_select("games",    order = "game_date.asc")

# Unfiltered season-wide data — kept separate so games_played and any
# per-game rate stat always reflect the whole season, even inside a
# single-game report, rather than that one game divided by 1.
faceoffs_all  <- sb_select("faceoffs")
turnovers_all <- sb_select("turnovers")
shots_all     <- sb_select("shots")
goals_all     <- sb_select("goals")
on_ice_all    <- sb_select("on_ice")
penalties_all <- sb_select("penalties")

# ── Filter to selected game if a game_id param was passed ──────────────────
filter_by_game <- function(df) {
  gid <- params$game_id
  if (is.null(gid) || is.na(gid) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df[df$game_id == as.integer(gid), ]
}

faceoffs  <- filter_by_game(faceoffs_all)
turnovers <- filter_by_game(turnovers_all)
shots     <- filter_by_game(shots_all)
goals     <- filter_by_game(goals_all)
on_ice    <- filter_by_game(on_ice_all)
penalties <- filter_by_game(penalties_all)

# ── Add xG to shots (both the game-scoped and season-wide copies) ──────────
shots     <- add_xg(shots)
shots_all <- add_xg(shots_all)

# ── Helper: join player name ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_player_name <- function(df, id_col = "player_id") {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df |> left_join(players |> select(id, jersey_num, full_name, position),
                  by = setNames("id", id_col))
}

add_game_label <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df |>
    left_join(games |> select(id, game_date, opponent),
              by = c("game_id" = "id")) |>
    mutate(game_label = paste0(game_date, " vs ", opponent))
}

faceoffs  <- faceoffs  |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
turnovers <- turnovers |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
shots     <- shots     |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
goals     <- goals    |>
  left_join(players |> select(id, scorer_name = full_name,
                              scorer_num = jersey_num),
            by = c("scorer_id" = "id")) |>
  add_game_label()
on_ice <- on_ice |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()

# ── Compute full player stats table ─────────────────────────────────────────
n_games_covered <- if (is.null(params$game_id)) nrow(games) else 1L

player_stats <- compute_player_stats(
  players   = players,
  shots     = shots,
  goals     = goals,
  faceoffs  = faceoffs,
  turnovers = turnovers,
  on_ice    = on_ice,
  penalties = penalties,
  n_games   = n_games_covered
)

# Always computed from full, unfiltered season data — used only to source
# games_played and any *_per_game rate column below, so those reflect the
# real season even when this report is scoped to a single game.
player_stats_season <- compute_player_stats(
  players   = players,
  shots     = shots_all,
  goals     = goals_all,
  faceoffs  = faceoffs_all,
  turnovers = turnovers_all,
  on_ice    = on_ice_all,
  penalties = penalties_all,
  n_games   = nrow(games)
)

per_game_cols <- c("games_played",
                   names(player_stats_season)[grepl("_per_game$", names(player_stats_season))])

player_stats <- player_stats |>
  select(-any_of(per_game_cols)) |>
  left_join(player_stats_season |> select(player_id, all_of(per_game_cols)),
            by = "player_id")

vt_goals  <- sum(goals$team == "VT",       na.rm = TRUE)
opp_goals <- sum(goals$team == "opponent", na.rm = TRUE)
vt_shots  <- shots[!is.na(shots$team) & shots$team == "VT", ]

# Both teams' shots, in scope for this report (game or season) — used by
# the combined shot maps below. Keep vt_shots above for VT-only stats.
all_shots_this_scope <- shots[!is.na(shots$team), ]
```

```{r overview}
#| echo: false
fo_wins  <- sum(faceoffs$result == "win",  na.rm = TRUE)
fo_total <- nrow(faceoffs)
cat(sprintf(
  "Games covered : %d\nScore         : VT %d — Opp %d\nShots         : %d\nFaceoffs      : %d W / %d (%.1f%%)\nTakeaways     : %d\nTeam xG       : %.2f\n",
  n_games_covered, vt_goals, opp_goals,
  nrow(vt_shots), fo_wins, fo_total,
  ifelse(fo_total > 0, fo_wins / fo_total * 100, 0),
  sum(turnovers$type == "takeaway", na.rm = TRUE),
  sum(vt_shots$xg, na.rm = TRUE)
))
```

---

# Team Summary

## Scoring & Shot Quality

```{r team-scoring}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shot data recorded yet.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
    summarise(
      `Shots`          = n(),
      `On Goal`        = sum(result %in% c("goal","save"), na.rm = TRUE),
      `Goals`          = sum(result == "goal", na.rm = TRUE),
      `Shooting %`     = paste0(round(mean(result == "goal", na.rm=TRUE)*100,1),"%"),
      `Total xG`       = round(sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
      `SQ`    = round(mean(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
      `GAE`     = round(sum(result == "goal", na.rm=TRUE) -
                                sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 2)
    ) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "VT Team Shooting") |>
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_column_labels())
}
```

## Shot Results Breakdown

```{r shot-results}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shot data.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
    count(result, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      result = case_match(result,
        "goal"    ~ "Goal",
        "save"    ~ "On Goal (Save)",
        "missed"  ~ "Missed Net",
        "blocked" ~ "Blocked",
        .default  = result),
      `%` = paste0(round(Count/sum(Count)*100, 1), "%")
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(Count)) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Shot Attempt Breakdown") |>
    cols_label(result = "Result")
}
```

## Shot Danger Zones

```{r danger-zones}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0 || sum(!is.na(vt_shots$x_coord)) == 0) {
  cat("No shot location data yet.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
  filter(!is.na(x_coord)) |>
  mutate(
    x_canon = to_canonical_xy(x_coord, y_coord, period)$x,
    y_canon = to_canonical_xy(x_coord, y_coord, period)$y,
    zone = classify_danger(x_canon, y_canon)
  ) |>
  group_by(zone) |>
  summarise(
    Shots  = n(),
    Goals  = sum(result == "goal", na.rm = TRUE),
    xG     = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    `Shooting %` = paste0(round(Goals/Shots*100, 1), "%"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(`% of shots` = paste0(round(Shots/sum(Shots)*100, 1), "%")) |>
  arrange(match(zone, c("High Danger","Medium Danger","Low Danger"))) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Shots by Danger Zone") |>
  data_color(columns = xG,
             palette = c("#f4cccc","#861F41"))
}
```

## Skater Stats

```{r skater-table}

if (nrow(player_stats) == 0) {

} else {
  player_stats |>

      G            = goals,
      A1           = a1,

      PTS          = points,

      S            = shots,
      `S%`         = shoot_pct,
      `xG`         = xg_total,
      `xG/GP`       = xg_per_game,
      `xG+/-`      = xg_plus_minus,
      `GAE`        = g_minus_xg,
      `SQ`         = xg_per_shot,
      `HD%`        = hd_pct,
      TA           = takeaways,
      GA           = giveaways,
      BLK          = blocks,
      PIM          = pim,
      PPG          = pp_goals,
      PPP          = pp_points,
      SHG          = sh_goals,
      SHP          = sh_points,
      `FO%`        = fo_pct
    ) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "VT Skater Stats") |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(xG, `xG/GP`, GAE, SQ), decimals = 2) |>

              locations = cells_column_labels()) |>

               columns = c(GP, G, A1, A2, PTS, `+/-`, S, `S%`, xG, `xG/GP`, `xG+/-`, GAE,
                           SQ, `HD%`, TA, GA, BLK, PIM, PPG, PPP, SHG, SHP, `FO%`)) |>
    cols_width(
      `#`     ~ px(40),
      Player  ~ px(140),
      Pos     ~ px(50),
      everything() ~ px(55)
    ) |>
    opt_table_font(size = px(12)) |>
    tab_options(table.width = pct(100)) |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_sorting = TRUE,
      use_search = FALSE,
      use_pagination = FALSE,
      use_compact_mode = TRUE,
      use_text_wrapping = TRUE
    )
}
```

**Column key:** GP = Games Played, G = Goals, A1/A2 = Primary/Secondary Assists, +/- = Plus/Minus, S% = Shooting %, xG = Expected Goals, xG/G = xG per Game, xG+/- = xG Plus/Minus, GAE = Goals above expected, SQ = Average shot quality (xG/Shot), HD% = High danger shot %, TA = Takeaways, GA = Giveaways, BLK = Blocked Shots, PIM = Penalty Minutes, PPG/PPP = Power Play Goals/Points, SHG/SHP = Short Handed Goals/Points, FO% = Faceoff win %

## Faceoff Leaderboard

```{r fo-leaders}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(faceoffs) == 0) {
  cat("No faceoff data.")
} else {
  faceoffs |>
    group_by(full_name, jersey_num) |>
    summarise(Total = n(), Wins = sum(result=="win", na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
    filter(Total >= 3) |>
    mutate(`Win %` = round(Wins/Total*100,1),
           Player  = paste0("#", jersey_num, " ", full_name)) |>
    arrange(desc(`Win %`)) |>
    select(Player, Total, Wins, `Win %`) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Faceoff Leaders", subtitle = "(min. 3 taken)")
}
```

## Turnover Leaders

```{r turnover-leaders}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(turnovers) == 0) {
  cat("No turnover data.")
} else {
  turnovers |>
    group_by(full_name, jersey_num, type) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0) |>
    mutate(
      takeaways = if ("takeaway" %in% names(pick(everything()))) takeaway else 0L,
      giveaways = if ("giveaway" %in% names(pick(everything()))) giveaway else 0L,
      net       = takeaways - giveaways
    ) |>
    select(Player = full_name, `#` = jersey_num,
           Takeaways = takeaways, Giveaways = giveaways, Net = net) |>
    arrange(desc(Takeaways)) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Turnover Leaders") |>
    data_color(columns = Takeaways, palette = c("#d62020","#ffffff","#228B22"))
}
```

```{r penalties-team}

if (nrow(penalties) == 0 || !all(c("team", "minutes") %in% names(penalties))) {
```

```{r penalties-player}
#| echo: false
vt_pen <- if (nrow(penalties) > 0 && all(c("team", "player_id", "minutes") %in% names(penalties)))
  penalties[!is.na(penalties$team) & penalties$team == "VT" & !is.na(penalties$player_id), ] else data.frame()

if (nrow(vt_pen) == 0) {
```

```{r penalties-type}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(penalties) == 0 || !all(c("team", "infraction") %in% names(penalties))) {
  cat("No penalty data recorded yet.")
} else {
  penalties |>
    mutate(Infraction = penalty_infraction_label(infraction),
           Team = ifelse(team == "VT", "Virginia Tech", "Opponent")) |>
    count(Infraction, Team) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Team, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-Infraction))) |>

}
```

# Shot Maps

## All VT Shots

```{r shot-map-all}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
loc_shots <- all_shots_this_scope[!is.na(all_shots_this_scope$x_coord), ]
if (nrow(loc_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shot location data yet.")
} else {
  # Normalize both teams' coords onto one consistent display side, same
  # convention used elsewhere — VT always shown attacking left.
  disp <- to_display_xy(loc_shots$x_coord, loc_shots$y_coord, loc_shots$period)
  loc_shots$x_coord <- disp$x
  loc_shots$y_coord <- disp$y
  draw_rink_both_teams(loc_shots, attack_right = FALSE)
}
```

## Shots by Period

```{r shot-map-period}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5

raw_loc_shots <- all_shots_this_scope[!is.na(all_shots_this_scope$x_coord), ]

if (nrow(raw_loc_shots) > 0) {
  for (per in unique(raw_loc_shots$period)) {
    sub <- raw_loc_shots[raw_loc_shots$period == per, ]
    lbl <- switch(per, "1"="1st Period","2"="2nd Period","3"="3rd Period",
                  "OT"="Overtime", per)
    p <- draw_rink_both_teams(sub, attack_right = vt_attacks_right(per)) +
      labs(title = lbl) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", color="#861F41"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r goalie-table}

goalie_stats <- compute_goalie_stats(shots = shots, on_ice = on_ice)

                           `HD SV%`, `MD SV%`, `LD SV%`)) |>
    cols_width(
      `#`     ~ px(40),
      Goalie  ~ px(140),
      everything() ~ px(60)
    ) |>
    opt_table_font(size = px(12)) |>
    tab_options(table.width = pct(100))
}
```

**Column key:** GP = Games Played, SA = Shots Against, SV = Saves, GA = Goals Against, SV% = Save Percentage, GAA = Goals Against Average (per game), xGA = Expected Goals Against, xGAA = xGA per game, GSAx = Goals Saved Above Expected, HD/MD/LD SV% = Save % by shot danger zone

## Goalie Shot Maps

```{r goalie-shot-maps}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
opp_shots <- shots[!is.na(shots$team) & shots$team != "VT" &
                   !is.na(shots$goalie_id) & !is.na(shots$x_coord) &
                   !is.na(shots$result) & shots$result %in% c("save", "goal"), ]

if (nrow(opp_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shots-against location data yet.")
} else {
  for (gid in unique(opp_shots$goalie_id)) {
    g_row <- players[players$id == gid, ]
    g_label <- if (nrow(g_row) > 0)
      paste0("#", g_row$jersey_num, " ", g_row$full_name) else paste0("Goalie ", gid)

    sub <- opp_shots[opp_shots$goalie_id == gid, ]
    # Normalize onto one consistent side, same as the app's personal
    # goalie shot maps: shots-against always cluster on the right.
    disp <- to_display_xy(sub$x_coord, sub$y_coord, sub$period)
    sub$x_coord <- disp$x
    sub$y_coord <- disp$y

    p <- draw_rink(sub, attack_right = FALSE) +
      labs(title = g_label) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "#861F41"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Advanced Analytics

## Goals Above Expected

```{r g-minus-xg}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
if (nrow(player_stats) == 0 || sum(player_stats$shots) == 0) {
  cat("No data yet.")
} else {
  player_stats |>
    filter(shots > 0) |>
    mutate(
      label = paste0("#", jersey_num, " ", full_name),
      color = ifelse(g_minus_xg >= 0, VT_ORANGE, VT_MAROON)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(label, g_minus_xg), y = g_minus_xg, fill = color)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Goals Above Expected (G − xG)",
         subtitle = "Orange = outperforming expectation  |  Maroon = underperforming",
         x = NULL, y = "G − xG") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

## Shot Quality vs Volume

```{r goals-vs-xg-quadrant}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6.5

if (nrow(player_stats) == 0 || sum(player_stats$shots) == 0) {
  cat("No data yet.")
} else {
  plot_data <- player_stats |>
    filter(shots > 0) |>
    mutate(label = gsub(" .*", "", full_name))  # last name only, like the screenshot

  x_mid <- mean(plot_data$xg_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_mid <- mean(plot_data$goals,    na.rm = TRUE)

  x_max <- max(plot_data$xg_total, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  y_max <- max(plot_data$goals,    na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = xg_total, y = goals)) +
    # Quadrant divider lines at the team average
    geom_hline(yintercept = y_mid, color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = x_mid, color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.6) +

    # Quadrant labels
    annotate("text", x = x_mid * 0.15, y = y_max * 0.97,
             label = "Finisher / Lucky", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = x_max * 0.98, y = y_max * 0.97,
             label = "Sniper", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = x_mid * 0.15, y = y_max * 0.03,
             label = "Bad", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = x_max * 0.98, y = y_max * 0.03,
             label = "No Finish / Unlucky", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = 1) +

    # One dot per player, with a non-overlapping name label pinned to it
    geom_point(color = "#861F41", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_label_repel(
      aes(label = label),
      fill = "#861F41", color = "white", fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.2, label.size = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x_max)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(title = "Goals vs Expected Goals",
         subtitle = "Lines mark team-average xG and Goals per player",
         x = "xGoals", y = "Goals") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

# Line Optimization

Units are forward trios (3 forwards) and defense pairs (2 defensemen) that were on the ice together for 5-skater shots. Every shot attempt, for or against, is scored with the xG model, and rates are per 100 shot events because time on ice is not tracked. In each lineup the best-scoring unit takes the heaviest deployment slot (forwards 35/30/20/15%, defense 45/35/20%), and no player is used twice.

```{r line-setup}
#| echo: false
line_events  <- build_line_events(shots, on_ice, players)
line_reports <- compute_line_reports(line_events)
lineups      <- line_build_lineups(line_reports)

line_gt <- function(df, title) {
  df |>
    dplyr::rename(Slot = deployment_slot, Unit = unit,
                  `Shot events` = events, Games = games,
                  `xGF/100` = xgf_per_100, `xGA/100` = xga_per_100,
                  `Net/100` = net_per_100) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = title) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(`xGF/100`, `xGA/100`, `Net/100`), decimals = 2) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_column_labels())
}

show_units <- function(df, title) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("Not enough on-ice shot data to build this yet.")
  } else {
    line_gt(df, title)
  }
}
```

Maximizes net xG per 100 shot events.

# Game-by-Game

```{r game-by-game}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(games) == 0) {
  cat("No games yet.")
} else {
  all_shots     <- sb_select("shots")
  all_goals     <- sb_select("goals")
  all_fo        <- sb_select("faceoffs")
  all_turnovers <- sb_select("turnovers")
  all_pen       <- sb_select("penalties")

  # sb_select() returns a bare zero-column data frame when a table has no
  # rows at all — backfill missing columns with the correct type so later
  # joins/filters work the same whether the table is empty or populated.
  # game_id must be integer to match games$id in the left_join() below.
  ensure_cols <- function(df, int_cols = character(0), chr_cols = character(0)) {
    for (col in int_cols) if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- integer(0)
    for (col in chr_cols) if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- character(0)
    df
  }
  all_shots     <- ensure_cols(all_shots,     int_cols = "game_id", chr_cols = "team")
  all_goals     <- ensure_cols(all_goals,     int_cols = "game_id", chr_cols = "team")
  all_fo        <- ensure_cols(all_fo,        int_cols = "game_id", chr_cols = "result")
  all_turnovers <- ensure_cols(all_turnovers, int_cols = "game_id", chr_cols = "type")
  all_pen       <- ensure_cols(all_pen, int_cols = c("game_id", "minutes"), chr_cols = "team")

  if (nrow(all_shots) > 0) {
    all_shots <- add_xg(all_shots)
  } else if (!"xg" %in% names(all_shots)) {
    all_shots$xg <- numeric(0)
  }

  games |>
    left_join(all_goals |> filter(team=="VT") |> count(game_id, name="GF"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_goals |> filter(team=="opponent") |> count(game_id, name="GA"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_shots |> filter(!is.na(team) & team=="VT") |>
                count(game_id, name="Shots"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_shots |> filter(!is.na(team) & team=="VT") |>
                group_by(game_id) |>
                summarise(xGF = round(sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE),2), .groups="drop"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_fo |> filter(result=="win") |>
                count(game_id, name="FO_W"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_fo |> count(game_id, name="FO_T"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_turnovers |> filter(type=="takeaway") |>
                count(game_id, name="TAs"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
        left_join(all_pen |> filter(team == "VT") |> group_by(game_id) |>
                summarise(PIM = sum(minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    mutate(across(c(GF,GA,Shots,FO_W,FO_T,TAs,PIM), ~replace_na(.x, 0L)),
           xGF    = replace_na(xGF, 0),
           `FO%`  = paste0(round(FO_W/pmax(FO_T,1)*100,0),"%"),
           Result = case_when(GF>GA~"W", GF<GA~"L", TRUE~"T")) |>
    arrange(game_date) |>
    select(Date=game_date, Opponent=opponent, Location=location,
           Result, GF, GA, Shots, xGF, `FO%`, TAs) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Game-by-Game Results") |>
    fmt_number(columns = xGF, decimals = 2) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color="#d4edda"), locations=cells_body(rows=Result=="W")) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color="#f4cccc"), locations=cells_body(rows=Result=="L")) |>
    cols_align(align="center", columns=c(Result,GF,GA,Shots,xGF,`FO%`,TAs))
}
```
